title: Choose Kitch's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Kirana Bill Book. Keep it, take the pick or the standard, or re-roll.

options.label: The Kirana Bill Book
options.lineage: Carbon-copy bill books from the neighbourhood kirana store
options.thesis: Every plan, cart, and order is an original you can check against its carbon copy.
materials: white original, canary and pink duplicates
options.viewport: Indigo rail, a dense Mon–Sun meal timetable with today's column inked, tonight's dinner with pantry/cart coverage, and Kitch's conversation docked on the right issuing numbered slips.
options.risk: Indigo shell is unusual for food apps; if the ink is timid it reads as generic SaaS purple.

raised.raise: Destructive actions (Empty pantry, Clear day, Place order) stand apart by deliberate space, never beside routine actions.
All seven days share one fixed scale, so a week of meals or macros compares at a glance.
Density courage: pantry and cart show every row at once; no accordions hiding stock.
Flat, unmodulated colour fields; no gradients, glass, or grain anywhere.
Macro emphasis rides one fixed size ramp instead of rings and gauges.
Hierarchy by scale and weight alone; no eyebrow labels or decorative pills.

options.label: The Steel Tiffin
options.thesis: Each day is a tiffin: three stacked tiers for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, latched together.
options.viewport: A row of seven tiffins for the week, today's opened to show its tiers; chat as a bar under the stack.
options.risk: The most familiar Indian-kitchen metaphor; steel greys can read cold or clinical.

options.label: Developer Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels with hairline seams and isolated destructive actions.
options.case: Loses both axes: a home kitchen is not a console, and dark-first fights daytime kitchen use.
options.risk: Costume of a tool the audience doesn't use.
options.kept: Destructive actions isolated by deliberate space.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: One plant through its seasons on fixed-scale plates.
options.viewport: Five aligned plates on one baseline.
options.case: Loses both axes: reads as an editorial artifact and lands in the cream-and-serif rut.
options.kept: One fixed scale across all seven days.

options.label: Event Catalog
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-size cells packed in a numbered grid.
options.case: Loses both axes: no cultural tie to a household kitchen.
options.risk: Noise for a calm daily tool.
options.kept: Density courage; show every row at once.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Flat colour lobes divided by coastlines.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful map geometry obscures tables, dates, and checkout state.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Magnitude as ranked dot size on navy.
options.case: Loses both axes: night-sky world has nothing to do with cooking.
options.kept: One fixed size ramp for emphasis.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Giant glyphs morphing under an axis slider.
options.case: Loses both axes: letterform play is not a kitchen task.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale and weight alone.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean meal-planning SaaS: white surfaces, one green accent, sidebar and cards, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, week calendar of meal cards, nutrition summary, floating chat.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other meal planner by design.
